content.introduction: The stock market experienced a significant sell-off due to rising bond yields and potential rate hikes, alongside seasonal market trends and upcoming IPOs. The S&P 500 saw a large one-day drop, breaking below its 20-day SMA. The VIX OI Change indicates a bearish outlook.
body: The spike in bond yields, and corresponding shift in expectations around potential rate hikes form the Federal Reserve is certainly a factor in today's market sell-off, but there are other factors in play: a) the S&P 500 rallied 20.6% from March 30th to Tuesday of this week without a healthy pullback to digest gains; b) the highly anticipated, and highest valued IPO in history, SpaceX, begins trading next Friday and investors may be raising funds by selling recent winners; c) the driver behind the recent rally has been AI-infrastructure optimism, which has continually been fueled by Q2 "beat and raise" earnings reports from AI-related companies, but now we are in-between earnings seasons; and d) the month of June is not bullish from a seasonality perspective. ![Image 2: S&P 500 seeing its largest one-day drop in two months and is dropping below its 20-dayu SMA for the first time since early April today.](https://educationcontent.schwab.com/sites/g/files/eyrktu1071/files/SPX%206-5.png?imwidth=3840).
